rounds.response:
Tags [DATA] and [STORY] are recommended (not mandatory) — please add them when posting to help moderators organize content.  
Use [STORY] for first‑person accounts, personal reactions, or family incidents (we can anonymize/move on request); use [DATA] for studies, statistics, foreign case law, and other empirical evidence.  
Comparative legal material used as evidence should go in the empirical thread; focused legal/procedural analysis of the bill (record‑keeping, complaint process) may remain in this main thread.  
If a post genuinely contains both research and a personal account, please split it into two posts (one in each thread) or indicate clearly which is primary; linking across threads is preferred to verbatim cross‑posting and is allowed.  
Electioneering or campaign strategy content is off‑topic and will be moved or removed unless directly tied to analysis of the bill’s text or expected legal/administrative effects.

rounds.consequence: Participants have largely adopted the [DATA]/[STORY] tags when they remember, and the split threads have reduced confusion in the main discussion. Your standing remains stable, and users are slightly more inclined to wait for your guidance instead of enforcing their own interpretations of the rules.
